hooks.description: Keep project-root .memory/ lean and index-shaped. On every write under .memory/, require each entry to declare `topic` + `description`, reject oversized entries, and rebuild a minimal topic-grouped INDEX.md so an agent loads only the index plus the single entry it needs.
Backstop for tool runtimes whose edit operations are not exposed as native hook events. At turn stop, scan project-root .memory/ and rebuild INDEX.md.

After editing code, format silently and lint with --fix, gated by extension: prettier + eslint for JS/TS/React/Next, rustfmt + clippy for Rust. Remaining lint errors exit 2 so the agent must fix them.

Backstop for regulated improvement loops. Only acts when .improve/active exists: if loop-ctl's latest directive still says continue, exit 2 to refuse a premature stop so the loop pivots instead of giving up.
